legal_claim_summary: FORMAL DISPUTE NOTICE: Delivery of Non-Genuine / Counterfeit SKU in Violation of OEM Licensing. The buyer 'Authorized Consumer' (consumer@sentinel.ai) hereby files this formal chargeback claim against merchant 'Amazon' regarding order 'ORD-FASTAPI-1234' for 'MacBook Pro 16 M3 Max' (INR 349,900.00). Incident: Serial number did not match Apple GSX database and chassis had non-OEM screws.
statutory_citations: Section 13.4 Counterfeit Goods Protection & Compulsory Merchant Forfeiture
Trade Marks Act § 103 / Lanham Act 15 U.S.C. Anti-Counterfeiting Provisions
Mastercard Dispute Resolution Standard § 4.1.3 Intellectual Property Infringement
demands: Immediate unconditional reversal of transaction to original payment instrument
Transmission of serial audit report to OEM brand protection division
